/* logo in the centre of the project ring, always in front of the cards */
.rg-lw{position:absolute;left:50%;top:var(--lgt,26%);z-index:5;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);pointer-events:none;width:min(380px,74vw)}
.rg-lw::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-26% -14%;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 50% 50%,rgba(31,36,58,.78),rgba(31,36,58,.45) 55%,rgba(31,36,58,0) 100%)}
.rg-lw .lw{display:block!important;width:100%!important;margin:0}
.rg-lw .hlogo{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.55)) drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(232,193,114,.25))!important}
.rg{--rgh:410px;--rgy:47%;--lgt:21%}
@media(max-width:1100px){.rg{--rgh:345px;--rgy:55%;--lgt:21%}}
@media(max-width:640px){.rg{--rgh:290px;--rgy:54%;--lgt:23%}}
@media(min-width:481px) and (max-width:640px){.rg{--rgh:320px;--rgy:57%;--lgt:22%}}
.rg-w{top:var(--rgy)!important}
.rg-lw{top:var(--lgt)}
.rg{height:var(--rgh)!important}
</style>
<style>
/* ===== contact: compact on laptop (option A), pop-up enquiry on phones (option C) ===== */
#contact.band{padding-block:clamp(40px,5vw,72px)}
#contact .cgrid{gap:clamp(24px,4vw,56px);align-items:start}
#contact .cside{gap:16px}
#contact .cside h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,56px);line-height:1}
#contact .cside .lead{font-size:16px;margin:0}
#contact .phone{padding:12px 0;gap:12px}
#contact .phone b{font-size:26px}
#contact .phone svg{width:20px;height:20px}
#contact form{gap:12px 14px;padding:clamp(18px,2.2vw,28px)}
#contact .f{gap:5px}
#contact .f label{font-size:12px}
#contact input,#contact select{min-height:44px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:15px}
#contact textarea{min-height:96px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:15px}
#contact .eqb,#contact .eqh,#contact .eqbg{display:none}
@media(max-width:640px){
  #contact .cgrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
  #contact .cside{text-align:center;justify-items:center}
  #contact .cside>div{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;width:100%}
  #contact .phone{border:1px solid var(--line)!important;padding:12px 18px;background:var(--panel);justify-content:center}
  #contact .phone b{font-size:22px}
  #contact .cside .loc{margin:0;font-size:14px}
  #contact .eqb{display:inline-flex;justify-self:center;margin-top:4px}
  #contact form{display:none;position:fixed;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:1001;max-height:calc(100dvh - 20px);overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35);padding:18px 16px 20px}
  #contact form.open{display:grid;animation:eqin .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
  #contact .f.full{grid-column:1/-1}
  #contact input,#contact select,#contact textarea{font-size:16px}
  #contact .eqbg:not([hidden]){display:block;position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:1000;background:rgba(21,19,15,.55)}
  #contact .eqh{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:2px;text-align:left}
  #contact .eqh h3{margin:0;font:500 26px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",serif}
  #contact .eqh p{margin:6px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.5}
  #contact .eqh a{color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}
  #contact .eqx{flex:none;min-height:40px;padding:0 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--ink);font:500 14px Jost,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
  body.eqopen{overflow:hidden}
}
@keyframes eqin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#contact form.open{animation:none}}
</style>
<style id="ribbon-bg-sample">
nav.ribbon{position:relative;isolation:isolate;border-top:1px solid var(--gold);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold);background:#14110d url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center 45%/cover no-repeat}
nav.ribbon::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:linear-gradient(rgba(16,13,10,.58),rgba(16,13,10,.58))}
nav.ribbon .rt a{color:#f7f1e3;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
nav.ribbon .rt a:hover,nav.ribbon .rt a:focus-visible{color:#e8c172}
nav.ribbon .rt i{color:#e8c172}
</style><style id="wt-hover-fix">
.wt{transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.wt:hover,.wt:active,.wt:focus-visible{background:#f4ecd8;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--gold)}
.wt:hover h3,.wt:active h3,.wt:focus-visible h3{color:var(--ink)}
.wt:hover p,.wt:active p,.wt:focus-visible p{color:#4a4338}
.wt:hover svg,.wt:active svg,.wt:focus-visible svg{stroke:#8a6a2c}
.wt{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
</style><style id="wt-bg">
.wt{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}
.wt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:right bottom;background-size:cover;opacity:.5;transition:opacity .4s,transform .8s;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(0,0,0,.35),#000 75%);mask-image:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(0,0,0,.35),#000 75%)}
.wt:hover::before,.wt:active::before,.wt:focus-visible::before{opacity:.62;transform:scale(1.04)}
